Your Job

DEPCOM Power, a Koch Engineered Solutions company and prominent renewable energy Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firm, is seeking an Assistant Project Manager
to join their team. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting large EPC projects. If you are in search of a challenging and gratifying opportunity within a dynamic and expanding company, this position could be an ideal fit for you.

This is a remote role that requires travel 50% to project sites.

This role does not provide Visa sponsorship.

Our Team

DEPCOM’s Project Delivery Organization executes full turnkey PV and BESS plants with collection substations and generation transmission lines. We utilize preferred partnerships with key vendors and subcontractors while coordinating with interconnection utilities across the nation. As a Koch Company, we implement Principle Based Management to continue driving innovation, hold our team to the highest standard and streamline our overall processes to ensure project success for each of our clients. As a supervisor, this includes helping your employees self-actualize and be all that they can be.

What You Will Do

Experience with cost estimating, scheduling, assessing project needs, scoping and/or customer interfacing
Valid Driver's license
Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or sponsorship

EPC experience in Solar, Wind, BESS, conventional power or industrial project

jobs.title: Project Manager Water (Belfast/ Cork/ Dublin)
jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

At Jacobs, we're helping to deliver some of the most important water, flood resilience and environmental infrastructure programmes across Ireland and Northern Ireland.

With unprecedented investment being made across water, wastewater, flood risk management and climate resilience, we're growing our Water Catchment Management and Maritime team and are looking for talented Project Managers and Senior Project Managers to help shape a more resilient and sustainable future.

Build a Career That Matters

Jacobs has secured multiple long-term frameworks and programmes with key clients across the island of Ireland, including Uisce Éireann, Dublin City Council, the Office of Public Works, Northern Ireland Water and the Department for Infrastructure. Our work spans flood resilience, water infrastructure, catchment management and environmental improvement programmes that directly benefit communities and the environment.

Our project portfolio covers

Flood risk management and flood alleviation schemes
Water and wastewater infrastructure
Catchment management programmes
Natural Flood Management solutions
Surface water management and SuDS
River engineering projects
Coastal and maritime infrastructure
Climate resilience programmes
Feasibility, appraisal and optioneering studies
Detailed design, construction support and project delivery

About The Role

Whether you're an experienced Project Manager looking to take the next step or a Senior Project Manager seeking greater responsibility, you'll play a key role in delivering complex multidisciplinary projects across Ireland and Northern Ireland.

You'll work closely with technical specialists, clients and delivery teams to successfully manage projects from concept through to completion.

Your Responsibilities

Lead multidisciplinary teams through feasibility, design, procurement, construction and commissioning phases.
Manage project scope, programmes, budgets and project risks.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project documentation, schedules, cost plans and progress reporting.
Support the successful delivery of major environmental and infrastructure programmes.
Ensure compliance with statutory requirements and project governance standards.
Drive innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement across project delivery.
Mentor and support junior project professionals while contributing to a collaborative team culture.

Here's what you'll need

We're keen to hear from professionals with project management experience across infrastructure, water or environmental sectors.

Your background could include

Water or wastewater infrastructure
Flood risk management
Flood alleviation schemes
Drainage and water resources
River engineering
Catchment management
Natural Flood Management
Surface water management and SuDS
Coastal or maritime engineering
Major civil infrastructure delivery
Design and construction management

You may also have experience with

NEC4 contracts
APM qualifications or chartership
Primavera or MS Project
Business case development (SOC, OBC, FBC)
BIM or digital project delivery tools

Most importantly, you'll bring strong leadership, stakeholder management and project delivery skills, along with a passion for solving complex environmental and infrastructure challenges.

Why Join Jacobs?

At Jacobs, you'll be part of a collaborative international team working on programmes that create lasting positive impact for communities across Ireland.

You'll have the opportunity to

✅ Deliver nationally significant infrastructure programmes

✅ Work alongside industry-leading specialists and multidisciplinary teams

✅ Build long-term client relationships

✅ Develop your career through exciting project opportunities

✅ Contribute to climate resilience and environmental improvement initiatives

✅ Grow within an inclusive and supportive culture where you can bring your whole self to work

Build. Lead. Innovate. Grow.

If you're a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager looking to work on some of Ireland's most important water, flood resilience and environmental programmes, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Jacobs and help shape the future of water infrastructure across Ireland and Northern Ireland.

Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees.

With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs.

We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.

Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles.

As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

Company Description
Taruneh helps organizations gain clear visibility into their workflows and information flows, identify bottlenecks, and design tailored software solutions to address them. The work typically starts with understanding the problem and analyzing business processes, and can extend to custom software development, systems integration, and implementation of management tools. Taruneh’s focus areas include process analysis and improvement, enterprise software development, CRM and workflow systems, management dashboards, and data-driven solutions. Each project’s scope and outcomes are defined based on the organization’s real challenges and context. More information about services and collaboration approaches is available at https://taruneh.com.

The Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for leading end-to-end analysis of business problems, documenting requirements, and translating them into practical solutions that align with Taruneh’s process and software capabilities. Day-to-day tasks include mapping and optimizing business processes, facilitating workshops with stakeholders, gathering and validating business requirements, and preparing clear documentation such as process maps, use cases, and functional specifications. The role also involves collaborating closely with product, design, and development teams to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with organizational goals, as well as supporting testing, change management, and user training where needed. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Baghdad, with a mix of on-site collaboration at client or company locations and some work-from-home flexibility.

Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and derive actionable insights.
Proficiency in business analysis and business requirements gathering, with experience turning complex needs into clear, structured documentation.
Experience in business process modeling and improvement, including mapping current workflows and designing optimized future states.
Excellent communication skills for facilitating workshops, interviewing stakeholders, and presenting findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, engineering, operations) on software or systems implementation projects.
Familiarity with common BA tools and techniques (e.g., BPMN, user stories, use cases, requirement traceability, UML or similar modeling tools).
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., CBAP, PMI-PBA) are an advantage.
Background in process improvement, digital transformation, or enterprise software/CRM/workflow systems is highly beneficial.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a hybrid work environment based in Baghdad.
